items.title: Buddy Burton Interview, 1959-09-07
items.q: I said I want you to arrange me a nice little arrangement and a melody in F in the jazz form see

ctx.x: Oh yes. I met him years ago.

Well now when he had his ranging office down in Lyon Healy building I went down there and explained to him what I was in for and what I wanted to do. I said Margie Lewis is a great pianist. I said you have never seen her. I said but I know that she can cut it. I said she can hold so much harmony on the piano and I got a trombone player from Louisville that used to play violin and could play trumpet and he could take trombone and play off a violin sheet and play the leads and he could sing tenor and so we're all…

tell a little bit more about Charlie Cook because I understand he died about a year or so ago last year I met him once in New York when he was arranging for Radio City but he had Freddie Keppert and Jimmy Noon some of the New Orleans fellas I didn't know where he came from he was from Louisville too I never knew that he was
